title: Sample cost segregation report walkthrough
description: A useful sample shows how a report moves from owner records to supported components, schedules, assumptions, and implementation questions. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Engineering study versus desktop analysis
description: The inspection format alone does not establish report quality. The relevant question is how physical facts and costs are identified, verified, and supported. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Cost segregation software versus professional study
description: Software output and an independently scoped professional engagement can involve different responsibilities and evidence. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Fixed fee versus percentage fee
description: A fixed price and a contingent or percentage-based price can create different commercial incentives and scope questions. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Cost segregation engagement exclusions
description: The exclusions often determine whether the final report meets the owner's expectations. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Verifying the study preparer's credentials
description: A general claim of engineering-based work does not identify who performs or reviews the analysis. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: What audit support actually includes
description: Audit support can range from answering technical questions to representation, with different contractual limits. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Reading a basis reconciliation
description: A component schedule is only useful when its total connects to the owner's supported depreciable costs. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Reading the component asset schedule
description: The component schedule should connect physical descriptions to costs and proposed depreciation treatment. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Understanding estimated replacement costs
description: A study may estimate costs when original detail is unavailable, but estimates need disclosed methods and assumptions. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Indirect construction costs in a study
description: Design, permitting, supervision, and other indirect costs need supported allocation to the relevant capital assets. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Land allocation evidence
description: A land allocation affects the starting depreciable basis, so it needs support beyond a preferred deduction amount. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Purchase closing costs and basis
description: A settlement statement can include acquisition costs, financing costs, prepaid expenses, and other items with different treatment. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Furnishings inventory template
description: An inventory should identify items, purchase or transfer dates, ownership, cost support, and current location. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Contractor invoice request template
description: An itemized contractor scope can reduce uncertainty about what was installed and what the quoted price covers. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Photograph submission checklist
description: Photographs support physical facts but do not prove purchase basis or filing eligibility. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Floor plan submission checklist
description: A floor plan helps identify unit boundaries, shared circulation, personal areas, and systems serving multiple spaces. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Placed-in-service evidence checklist
description: Readiness for intended use is a separate question from purchase, payment, or first rental receipts. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Prior depreciation request template
description: The provider and preparer need the existing schedule to avoid duplicate depreciation and unsupported catch-up estimates. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: CPA implementation responsibility checklist
description: The study and the filed return are separate deliverables requiring a clear handoff. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Form 3115 scope questions
description: Accounting-method change analysis and filing should be explicitly assigned rather than presumed included. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Federal versus state depreciation schedules
description: A federal depreciation conclusion does not establish identical state deductions. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Current deduction versus suspended loss
description: Accelerated depreciation can create a loss that is not currently usable by the owner. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Holding-period feasibility worksheet
description: The value of changing deduction timing depends partly on how long the asset will be held. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Incremental depreciation comparison
description: A feasibility estimate should compare the proposed schedule with depreciation available without the study. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Study-fee break-even analysis
description: A break-even model should use realistic usable tax benefits and all relevant costs. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Comparing two study proposals
description: Comparable proposals require the same property list, evidence assumptions, and deliverables. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: How to challenge a report assumption
description: An owner can improve a study by supplying evidence that corrects or narrows an assumption. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Version control for cost segregation reports
description: Report revisions should remain traceable to the schedules actually implemented. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Cost segregation records retention plan
description: Property evidence may remain relevant through later depreciation and disposition years. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Secure document sharing with a provider
description: Cost segregation files can contain ownership and financial information that deserves controlled access. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: New-construction cost ledger
description: A construction ledger should connect contracts, changes, credits, and owner-direct purchases to the completed project. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Change-order reconciliation
description: Change orders can alter quantities, scope, price, and completion dates. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Demolition and removal records
description: Removed components and new additions need separate evidence and preparer analysis. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Partial disposition evidence package
description: A proposed partial disposition needs an identifiable removed asset and support for its historical basis. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Repair versus improvement handoff
description: An expense label in bookkeeping is not a final capitalization conclusion. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Ownership evidence before a study
description: A study should identify the property interest and assets the taxpayer actually owns. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Multi-building report structure
description: A campus or portfolio report should preserve building-level costs and shared-asset allocations. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Report-to-books reconciliation
description: The study schedule and accounting records should connect through a documented adjustment bridge. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: CPA referral engagement boundaries
description: A referral arrangement should explain who contracts with the client and who performs each task. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Property manager referral checklist
description: Managers can gather property evidence while the owner and preparer retain key decisions. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Cost segregation for a small rental decision
description: A small-property decision depends on supported basis and usable incremental benefit, not just purchase price. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Rush study delivery questions
description: A fast delivery promise should specify when the clock starts and what incomplete records do to timing. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: How a feasibility estimate differs from a study
description: An initial estimate can help scope work but is not the completed component analysis. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: How to read a study limitations section
description: Limitations describe unavailable information, reliance on estimates, and tasks outside the scope. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Organizing a rental asset sale file
description: A sale file should match transaction allocations with the seller's implemented asset history. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Study review meeting agenda
description: A short structured review can resolve the most consequential issues before filing. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: What a documented client case study should show
description: A useful case study separates verified work from illustrative modeling and protects client confidentiality. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Cost segregation classification issue log
description: An issue log records unresolved physical, costing, or tax questions before the final schedule is released. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.

title: Second-opinion study review
description: A second opinion should identify a specific concern and evaluate the supporting evidence before recommending changes. Practical cost segregation buyer guidance from Stratum.
